assumptions.choice: ICT Midnight Open level approximated by the previous session's close
assumptions.reason: The feed has only daily AAPL OHLCV for the regular session; there is no 00:00 ET overnight/futures session to source a literal Midnight Open. Since a stock's price is unchanged while the market is closed, the prior close is the closest available proxy, which makes this condition/target numerically identical to the Gap-Fill condition/target.

assumptions.choice: Spike high proxied by the signal day's daily High
assumptions.reason: The 'initial upward spike after the open' requires an intraday price path, which daily OHLCV bars do not provide; the day's full High is the closest available substitute for that local maximum.

assumptions.choice: Only the aggressive entry (short at the signal day's open) is implemented; the conservative entry (wait for the spike to complete/reverse before entering) is omitted
assumptions.reason: Conservative entry requires detecting an intraday spike-and-reversal in real time, which cannot be evaluated from once-per-day bars.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss uses the general 'above the spike high' rule instead of a fixed dollar offset for the aggressive entry
assumptions.reason: The spec's $70-80 aggressive stop width is explicitly stated as a YM (Dow futures) figure with no stated AAPL equivalent; scaling it would invent a threshold the spec never gives.

assumptions.choice: No additional probability filter beyond the three stated Outside-Day/Gap-Up/ICT conditions is implemented
assumptions.reason: The specification text is cut off mid-sentence ('Probability filter: The strategy'), so the intended rule is unknown and cannot be implemented without inventing it.

assumptions.choice: Each TP level triggers a full close (self.close()) of the position the first time any of the three levels is touched, rather than scaling out fixed fractions
assumptions.reason: The spec allows closing 'partially or fully' at each level but never states a split ratio; the bench's canonical default maps 'exit/close the position' to self.close(), so a full close on first touch avoids fabricating an unstated percentage split.

assumptions.choice: Entry is submitted as a plain self.sell() once conditions are confirmed on the signal day's bar
assumptions.reason: Order fill timing is governed by the harness-configured broker (non-cheat-on-open by default), so the order fills at the following bar's open rather than the signal day's own open; this is standard behavior for a next()-issued market order on daily bars, not a strategy-level choice.
